Work in C:\Users\edmem\kodely-prod (a Next.js 16 + Prisma app called Kodely — an AI website builder at kodely.me).

TASK: audit every capability and pricing claim on the marketing pages against what the code actually does, and fix what's wrong.

## Why this matters now
A parallel effort just found that published blog content overstates the product in several places, and that the one public per-build credit figure ("roughly 100–150 credits") is contradicted by measurement. The marketing pages have never been checked the same way. A claim on the pricing page is a promise attached to a payment.

## Ground truth — verify every claim against these, do not trust the copy
- `lib/agent.ts` — the SYSTEM prompt. **The definitive statement of what a generated site can contain.** Read it in full. Note it was just given two new rules (never invent business facts; never build a control that only pretends to work).
- `lib/foundation.ts` — the starting project and its only dependencies.
- `app/api/site/[slug]/**` — `SANDBOX_CSP`. No external hosts at all. There is no `font-src`, so even a base64 `@font-face` is blocked.
- `lib/credits.ts` — `MICROS_PER_CREDIT`, `SIGNUP_GRANT`, `estimateCredits` (**note: it has ZERO callers — no cost estimate is shown in the UI today**), `averageBuildCredits`, the spend cap.
- `lib/stripe.ts` — the real credit packs and prices.
- `app/api/generate/route.ts` — the no-charge-on-failure behaviour, and the repair loop.
- `app/api/projects/[id]/export/route.ts` — zip export. **Built but NOT yet deployed.**
- `lib/site-seo.ts` — what SEO handling actually happens.
- `app/api/projects/[id]/publish/route.ts` — publishing only ever returns `<slug>.kodely.site`. **No custom domains.**

**Known-false things to hunt for:** working contact forms, bookings, accounts/logins on generated sites, carts/checkout, databases, external API integrations, stock or uploaded images, custom web fonts, multi-page sites, custom domains, npm packages beyond react/react-dom, or any "see the cost before you build" claim.

**A specific number to check everywhere:** `SIGNUP_GRANT` is 750 and appears hardcoded in several places (`app/pricing/page.tsx`, `app/(auth)/signup/page.tsx`, `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`'s CTA). Find every literal copy and make each one derive from the constant, so it can never drift.

**On per-build cost: publish no number.** Measurements so far are 144 and 472 credits — a 3x spread on two samples. `estimateCredits`'s own comment says that is not a distribution. If any page states or implies a per-build cost, remove the figure rather than replacing it.

## Scope — YOU MAY ONLY EDIT: `app/pricing/**`, `app/page.tsx`, `components/marketing/TrustBento.tsx`, `components/marketing/FeatureVisuals.tsx`, `components/marketing/WhatPeopleBuild.tsx`
READ anything. If a false claim lives in a file outside this list, DO NOT edit it — report the exact file, line and claim instead.

## Critical constraints
- **This is a correctness pass, not a rewrite.** Keep the voice, structure and design. Change a sentence when it is untrue or unsupportable; do not restyle, restructure, or "improve" copy that is accurate.
- Do not weaken genuinely true and valuable claims. Real strengths, all verifiable: sites are real Vite+React+TS+Tailwind apps rather than HTML mockups; a build that fails to compile is never charged; credits are metered from real token usage against a published rate; there is a user-settable spend cap; published sites get real title/meta/OG handling.
- **Do not add new white text on the brand gradient** — it fails colour contrast (worst 1.81:1) and that is a known accepted issue; don't make it worse.
- The public pages just passed an accessibility review — preserve `<main id="main-content">` landmarks, `SkipLink`, form labels, `aria-*`, and `focus-visible:` styles. Do not regress them.
- DO NOT modify: prisma/schema.prisma, anything under lib/, app/api/**, app/blog/**, app/legal/**, app/templates/**, app/projects/**, app/dashboard/**, app/settings/**, app/admin/**, app/globals.css, other files under components/marketing/, proxy.ts, deploy.sh, .env, package.json.
- DO NOT add npm dependencies. DO NOT run `npm run build`, `git commit`, `git push`, or `deploy.sh`.
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx eslint app lib components`; BOTH must be clean — the repo is at zero lint errors and must stay there.

## Report back
Every claim you found that was false or unsupportable, with file:line and what you changed it to; every hardcoded 750 you replaced; false claims you found OUTSIDE your editable scope (file, line, exact text); and any claim you were unsure about and why.
